name: Greece
geometry_note: Natural Earth country polygon intersected with the FIRMS API rectangle (19.0, 34.5, 29.8, 42.0); one record: yearly archives up to 2024 (Terra, Aqua, S-NPP) and the FIRMS API from 2025 (all platforms; NOAA-20/21 from the API throughout); confidence filter and persistent-pixel rule, no `type` filter. Links are trained on 2018-04-01..2023-12-31 (S-NPP to NOAA-20) and 2024-01-17..2025-06-30 (NOAA-20 to NOAA-21).
